title: Tim Taylor's hooded figure before his invention download

tellings.quote: morning he said grant the last thing I remember the night before I got that idea in my head I woke up and there was a hooded figure standing at the end of bed

plain: The night before an idea for an invention arrived in his head, Timothy Taylor, the scientist written about in a book by an author Cameron calls Pulko, woke to find a hooded figure standing at the end of his bed. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says Taylor told him this directly: "the last thing I remember the night before I got that idea in my head I woke up and there was a hooded figure standing at the end of bed." If true, it would tie the invention to some kind of visitor.
